script_text: Cancer — the cosmos is about to rearrange your emotional landscape this week. Your ruling planet, the Moon, governs your Water element energy, forming a square with Saturn on Monday, creating tension between your heart and responsibilities. By Tuesday, Mercury sextiles Neptune, giving you clarity around romantic relationships. Wednesday remains heavy as the Moon transits your 4th House of home and security. Thursday shifts everything when Venus enters your 7th House of partnerships, softening every connection and opening doors. The weekend brings Jupiter trining Pluto in your 10th House of career, unlocking a professional opportunity you did not expect. Sunday's full Moon in Pisces activates your 12th House, urging rest before the next cycle begins. Your power day is Thursday — avoid Monday when the Moon squares Saturn in your career sector. Trust the quiet moments — your intuition is sharper than any forecast. Follow for daily updates.
